hard_gates.gate: G1 tenant isolation, real product (critic's own attack)
hard_gates.evidence: Seeded demo on :21150, tenant A admin@alnoor against tenant B admin@gulfsteel. B uploaded a canary file (b-secret-canary-Q7Z.txt). With B's ids, A got 404 on: list of B's contact files (also with X-Tenant-Id), upload to B's contact (bytes and JSON), content and content?inline of B's file, a traversal path, and B's file id under another kind. A's file search for 'b-secret' and 'Q7Z' returned []. DELETE of B's file answered 204 (it is idempotent by design) and B's file was still there and readable by B afterwards. The 'Trade licence' and 'Delivery note' searches give 5 matches per tenant with no shared ids, and B cannot read any of A's seeded files. Traversal names ('../../etc/passwd.txt', '..\\x.txt', '../<B hex>/evil.txt', 'a/b/c.txt', RLO) are stored as clean base names. DB: attachments.files has RLS enabled and forced (tenant_id = erp.current_tenant_id()). erp_app, erp_worker, erp_owner and erp_auth have no BYPASSRLS and are not superusers. erp_app with no tenant set sees 0 rows; erp_worker has no access to the schema. Bytes are kept in /data/attachments/<tenant hex>/<random id>. A CHECK ties storage_key to tenant_id. No export or job reads attachments. Files: probes/attack.mjs, probes/attack-output.txt, probes/db-checks.txt

hard_gates.evidence: plant.diff and plant-gates-run.log. Plant A: the file search caches results by kind and text with no tenant in the key (a cross-tenant leak). Caught by G1ProcessStateTests.Process_wide_state_is_immutable_or_reviewed and by G1AttachmentsAttackTests, which found 4 leaks: tenant A's search for B's seeded file names returned B's file ids. biggest_gap.title: Files can be attached only to contacts, not to any record
biggest_gap.detail: The spec says 'upload, download, preview and delete files on any record'. Only the contacts module registers a kind of record that takes files. Companies, branches, users, roles, currencies and every other record with a form have no attachments section, no paperclip and no file endpoints. A UAE trading or manufacturing company keeps its trade licence, TRN certificate and tenancy contract on the company or branch, and staff documents on the user, so it would still go to Odoo, where every record with a chatter takes files. Round 1's critic listed this, and round 3 did not extend it. Everything else in p11 now beats Odoo on its two compared tasks.
biggest_gap.evidence: curl -s localhost:<port>/api/openapi/v1.json | grep -o '"/api/attachments/[^"]*"' lists only /api/attachments/contacts.contacts/... (5 routes). GET /api/attachments/identity.users/files/<id>/content answers 404 (no such kind; probes/attack-output.txt). Source: the only AttachmentRecord registration is src/Modules/Contacts/Erp.Modules.Contacts/ContactsModule.cs:55. web/src/modules/attachments/RecordFiles.tsx:12-17 lists only 'contacts.contacts' in attachmentKinds and recordRoutes. Open any company or branch form in the demo: there is no paperclip and no attachments section.

other_findings: Audit display: the record header's last-change line shows a file change as if it were a change to the contact itself. After a file is removed, a contact that is not deleted reads 'Deleted by Mariam Al Mansoori · 16 Nov 2026, 2:59 PM' under its title. In Arabic it reads 'حذفه فاطمة الزعابي'. After an upload it reads 'Created by ...', with the upload time as if the contact were created then. The History panel does tag the same row 'Attachment', but the header does not. Repro: delete any file of a contact, reopen it, and read the line under the names. Screenshots en-01-contact-top.jpg, ar-01-contact-top.jpg, en-10-record-history-files.jpg. Likely cause: round 3 links the attachments.files audit rows to the parent record (OwnerField/ParentKindField), and the header's verb is taken from the file row's action.

File types: TIFF (scanned documents) and HEIC (phone photos) are refused with 415. zip, eml and msg are now accepted (probes/types-output.txt). Arabic file names are stored and found by the file search ('رخصة تجارية.pdf').

Fixed since round 1 and confirmed in the browser in English and Arabic by keyboard: a paperclip with a count in the toolbar, Alt+A to the files, the newest three names under the heading (one click opens a file), Ctrl+K file search that opens the record and shows the file, text preview (RTL text shown in its own direction), a table that no longer cuts Delete, file changes in the History panel, and 'Added by' filled for seeded files. Several files at once through the chooser, drag and drop with a refused .exe explained in place, delete confirm (focus starts on Cancel: Enter, Tab, Enter), and keyboard download all work. No 5xx and no page errors in any run.

Keyboard note, not a product fault: in a fresh headless page, Enter on an 'Add files' button that only had programmatic focus did not open the file chooser (Space and click did). After a real gesture, Alt+A then Enter opened it every time (browser/fc.mjs, browser/fc2.mjs).
